scientific_limitations_integrity.finite_checks: Direct enumeration for alphabet sizes 3 and 4 through length 8; finite checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations_integrity.limitations: No result is claimed for repeated-symbol patterns, longer patterns, or occurrence counts other than two.
scientific_limitations_integrity.novelty_risk: A later paper mentions an in-preparation automaton treatment of a general m-ary frequency conjecture; its full text is unavailable and may contain related special cases.
scientific_limitations_integrity.proof_basis: Disjoint exhaustive case split by the positive contributions Z_j T_j, followed by a unique neutral-symbol insertion decomposition.
scientific_limitations_integrity.scope: Literal subsequences of length three with pairwise distinct symbols; exactly two occurrences.
